visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard and mustache, wearing a light grey crewneck sweatshirt, sits at a dark wooden table in a brightly lit indoor room. He slams a flat piece of black cardboard down and begins folding its edges upward with both hands. The background shows a neutral-toned wall and a blurred interior setting. (2) The man continues creasing the cardboard to form a rectangular tray, looking directly at the camera with a slight smile. An inset image showing a boxed pair of pliers with red handles appears on the left side of the screen. His hands move rhythmically to shape the packaging materials. (3) The man picks up a pair of pliers still in their yellow and red blister packaging and places them into the newly assembled black tray. He then picks up a black cardboard sleeve featuring gold logos and slides it smoothly over the tray to complete the product box. (4) He holds up the finished, sleek black box for the viewer to see, then sets it down on the table to join a small stack of other finished boxes. He gestures confidently towards the completed task, looking satisfied with the artisanal packaging process.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to highlight the craftsmanship and individual care put into the packaging of the 'Love Pliers' product. By showing the manual folding process, the creator reinforces a sense of premium quality and brand dedication, while humorously explaining that the box's primary role is protection, even if customers mistake it for the main product itself due to its high aesthetic appeal.
